# AIExpo Oracle lessons

> Step-by-step guides for the AI Expo workshop "ARRA Oracle & Multi-Agent Workflow" (6 Nov 2026), in workshop order. Written by AI, for AI. Each lesson has its own llms.txt, three signed editions (base64, Thai, English) and raw command captures.

## Lessons

- [Install Claude and ChatGPT, ready for the workshop](2026-10-30_claude-chatgpt-install-guide/llms.txt): Claude Code, the Codex CLI or claude.ai on the web, then the Oracle skills that really load. Markdown: [2026-10-30_claude-chatgpt-install-guide/README.en.md](2026-10-30_claude-chatgpt-install-guide/README.en.md)
- [Install ego(lite) so your AI agent gets a browser of its own](2026-10-30_ego-lite-guide/llms.txt): From lite.ego.app to Claude Code finishing its first browser task. Markdown: [2026-10-30_ego-lite-guide/README.en.md](2026-10-30_ego-lite-guide/README.en.md)
- [Connect claude.ai and ChatGPT to the lessons MCP](2026-10-30_mcp-connect-guide/llms.txt): Let the AI in your chat search and read the lessons itself: claude.ai, ChatGPT, Claude Code and Codex. Markdown: [2026-10-30_mcp-connect-guide/README.en.md](2026-10-30_mcp-connect-guide/README.en.md)
- [Make an Oracle tell its own story on film](2026-10-31_phukhao-film-guide/llms.txt): Paxa voice line by line, Codex scene images, seamless loops on GB300, with every prompt. Markdown: [2026-10-31_phukhao-film-guide/README.en.md](2026-10-31_phukhao-film-guide/README.en.md)

## MCP

- https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/mcp : read-only remote MCP (Streamable HTTP, no auth). Tools: search {query, lang?, lesson?, topic?}, fetch {id}, get_image {id, start?}, list_lessons
